purpose: Directional entailment lattice for ATOM-LEVEL SEMANTIC RELATION classification (relation-contract-v2 section 5). This is the relation layer's lattice: it decides what the source proposition semantically establishes about the claim atom. It does not replace, weaken, or modify the frozen support-boundary modality table (../rc3-1-support-boundary/modality-boundary-table.json), which continues to gate AUTO_SUPPORT eligibility.

relations.condition: claim context inherits/binds the source condition; otherwise NOT_ENTAILED

relations.note: same proposition and scope: positive incompatibility, may support CONTRADICTS per contract section 6
prohibition is stronger than absence of requirement; weaker-directional, no positive conflict on deontic force alone

weakness_rule: A source strictly weaker than the claim (PERMITTED vs REQUIRED, POSSIBLE vs ENTITLED, CONDITIONAL vs unconditional) is NOT_ENTAILED: the claim is not established. Without positive incompatibility the relation is RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT or PARTIAL (contract section 8), never CONTRADICTS.
separation_note: Relation output and boundary output remain independent. A DEONTIC_OPPOSITION relation with boundary BOUNDARY_COMPATIBLE still does not by itself authorize AUTO_CONTRADICTED; existing contradiction-proof requirements apply.
